full_page.content:
Page 222 Cont.
July
Loraine Wilcox - 35 - brok .- arm 6 weeks To-day - arm still very stiff.
Patricia Connanghton - 6 - about a year ago had threatening diabetis - was prayed for in October. Now quite astonishing doctors.
10 Nancy Medico - 14 - had stroke when 6 quite helpless ever since. Enrolled To-day.
Bernard Weir of Cleveland - 8 - pupil of Eye punctured - Drs. had little hope of saving Eye ... was Enrolled some weeks ago ... now quite hopeful out-look.
Robert Martin - 7 - very threatening ailment like brain - Tuomer of brain.
Page 223 July 11 John Strackouskas - 45 - Veteran Hosp'1 - Hard of hearing since operation 3 weeks ago. Xrays show it effect of bad kidney - find both kidnies bad ... too bad to be disturbed "nothing in their power to be done. Wife and 3 living children pray . Enrolling him in Ser. Mass A. 1.00
Priscella Stencil - 34 - mother of three small children - serious kidney trouble.
12 Ambrose Stach - 13 - accidently shot through the temple; left Detroit June 22 for vacation in N. Dakota. Boys went out last Sunday p.m .... bullet still in head causing grave condition. Patient was in hope to go to seminary next yr. Enrolled Today 50c
E'd J. Masterson - 44 - had cancer removed with lower jaw last May - hope the cancer may not return. Enrolled.
12 John Masterson (Nephew) 15 - had serious accident 23rd of last month .... wandered away from scene of accident and as yet has not been located. Enrolled To-day.
Page 224 July 16 Henry Pollock - 53 - Episcop. - very serious stomach trouble - Pat Foody - with whom he fights now and then about religion, Enrolls him in Ser. M. Ass'n and asks prayers ...
